use-case-tumour-rna-fusion-detection.rejected: setting_append was not approved: setting is pinned. inputs and exclusions unchanged.

evidence_gaps_replace.from: No linked study compares short-read and long-read callers on the same samples.
evidence_gaps_replace.to: Short- and long-read evidence on the same RNA comes from one cell line (Huh7), with calls pooled over callers per platform (Dorney et al. 2026 preprint); no per-caller comparison across platforms on the same samples is linked.

evidence_gaps_add: Only one workflow (Arriba with manual review) is scored against orthogonal clinical assays (Kim et al. 2025, acute leukaemia); its specificity counts RNA-seq-only fusions as errors, although some are well-known recurrent fusions and one was confirmed by RT-PCR and Sanger sequencing.
Long-read caller precision and recall come from simulated reads only; on cancer cell lines only counts of known and other calls are available.
